changelog:
- Initial release of yoooclaw-world-cup-post-match-review-scene-en skill.
- Generates standardized and concise post-match reviews for World Cup football matches.
- Supports user input for teams, match events, review type, and relevant fan groups or apps.
- Offers four output types: one-sentence summary, match analysis, best performer, and hot topics after the game.
- Clearly distinguishes match status (ended, in progress, not started) before generating reviews.
- Integrates real-time notification retrieval for hot topics in fan groups when required.
summary: Used to generate post-match reviews of World Cup football matches, and supports standardized scene input, post-match information retrieval and fan group noti...
